name: Camping 101: Mining

angles.text: As a miner, you can shape a lodestone to strengthen your wilderness campsite and aid allies resting beside you.
As a cook, you can learn to tend a campfire, the foundation for specialized camp equipment.
As an Alliance tradesfolk, you can learn from Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to turn earthcraft into practical field tools.

faq.answer: Gelman Stonehand teaches miners in Stormwind to craft a lodestone for a wilderness campsite. You must prove your mining skill to learn the craft.
Gelman Stonehand is a mining trainer in Stormwind City. He teaches qualified miners to make a lodestone for expeditions in the wild.
A lodestone set at a wilderness campsite strengthens warriors and other fighters gathered around its campfire.
Stormwind's townsfolk disapprove of camps in city squares and streets. Go beyond the settlement gates to make camp and set your lodestone in the wilderness.
faq.q: Can I set up camp inside Stormwind?

aliases: do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: A campfire is the foundation of a campsite, and specialized gear like a lodestone is useless without one. Cooks teach travelers to start fires with wood and flint.
faq.q: Why do I need a campfire to set up camp?

faq.answer: Anyone who fights with a blade, axe, or hammer can benefit from a lodestone. Fighters seek its added strength while resting by the flames before a dangerous battle.
faq.q: Who benefits most from gathering around a Lodestone?

sections.body: Miners in Stormwind can shape the earth’s natural magnetism into a lodestone. At an expedition’s campsite, it bolsters the fighting strength of those gathered there. Gelman Stonehand, Stormwind’s mining instructor, teaches the craft to prospectors who prove their skill with a pickaxe.
sections.title: The Earth's Resonant Power

sections.body: A lodestone belongs in the wild, far from Cathedral Square and the Trade District. Townsfolk disapprove of travelers camping within city limits, so pioneers must head into the wild to make camp. The stone also needs a campfire. Cooks across the realm teach this basic wilderness skill.
sections.title: Wilderness Camps and Campfires

summary: In Stormwind, Gelman Stonehand teaches miners to shape a lodestone for camps in the wild. Set by a campfire, it strengthens the fighters gathered there.
